description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Anurid Scavenger triggers, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your draw step, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat.
